I had a special participation in the Rádio Novelo Apresenta podcast episode
[Deixa a vida me levar](https://radionovelo.com.br/originais/apresenta/deixa-a-vida-me-levar/#_),
which tells the story of Tico's extraordinary journey.

The podcast is in Portuguese.

If you have been following the Tico story through my research and related outreach, this episode offers another perspective on that trajectory and the people involved in it.
